# Ferry timetable change — 2026-10-09

**Participants:** Tamsin Oduya (Operations), Rolf Benedek (Dispatcher)

Tamsin: "The last ferry moves from 22:40 to 21:55 on weekdays from November. The late sailing carried under ten passengers a night."

Rolf: "The weekend timetable stays as it is; Friday and Saturday late sailings still fill."
